mechanism: Rasagiline (MAOI-B) inhibits monoamine oxidase, potentially increasing dopamine and norepinephrine levels when combined with levodopa, risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome.
action: Co-administration is contraindicated; if rasagiline must be used, allow 14-day washout after levodopa discontinuation or use alternative antiparkinsonian agents with MAOIs.
